description: Implement train command in isolated uv environment using PyTorch MPS, full fine-tuning, batch 1/gradient accumulation 16, AdamW lr 5e-5, max 3 epochs. Train full and edit separately with the same fixed data split and seed. Validate checkpoint quality by execution on a deterministic 200-case development subset each epoch, evaluate all development cases for best checkpoint selection. Checkpoint stores optimizer, step, RNG, config, model/tokenizer/dataset hashes and elapsed budget. Enforce 24-hour wall-time cap per initial model run; resume consumes remaining budget, not a fresh cap. No cloud fallback.
